headline: Baku Qualifying Day: Antonelli and Mercedes chase pole at Baku City Circuit
whyCareReason: Qualifying Friday in Baku decides the 51-lap grid for Saturday's Grand Prix. Kimi Antonelli defends an 81-point championship lead around the tricky street circuit.
teaser: Friday 25 September: FP3 and Qualifying at Baku City Circuit. Grand Prix Saturday 26 September. Championship leader Antonelli 292.
story:
Why this one matters: Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend reaches maximum speed on Friday 25 September as Formula 1 stages FP3 and Qualifying at the Baku City Circuit.

With the Grand Prix scheduled for Saturday to observe Sunday's Remembrance Day, Friday afternoon's qualifying session sets the 51-lap grid. Drivers must balance extreme top speed along the 2.2-kilometer Neftchilar Avenue straight against surgical downforce through the 7.6-meter castle chicane.

Mercedes holds the championship high ground with Kimi Antonelli on 292 points and George Russell on 211. Ferrari (Hamilton 191, Leclerc 167) and McLaren (Norris 186, Piastri) bring low-drag packages aiming to disrupt Mercedes' front row dominance.
stakes: A Saturday race on a street circuit, with an 81-point lead that has not been tested in Azerbaijan.
rivalryAngle: Mercedes versus the rest, on a track that rewards the long straight and punishes the castle section.
